info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Parking Reservations Checkouts-v4-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Checkouts API allows users to access and list the checkout details of parking reservations. This endpoint supports businesses in managing their parking space utilization by providing comprehensive insights into active and completed checkouts. Typical consumers of this API may include parking management systems and mobile applications offering parking solutions. By leveraging this functionality, developers can enhance user experience through efficient reservation monitoring and reporting.

get.summary: Retrieve the checkout details for reservations
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the checkout information related to their reservations, including payment options, pricing, and any other relevant details to complete the booking process.
